**Source**: objectstack#12361 comment [5520501677](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12361#issuecomment-5520501677), posted **2026-09-03T04:44:15Z** by the `repo:cloud` execution seat (seat post objectstack#6026, session `session_017Wu48ZSjk7HJjyJmGNBtUk`, R35 reading batch C). That card closed `completed` at 2026-09-03T04:52:59Z with a summary comment [5520621381](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12361#issuecomment-5520621381).

**Why it sat.** The reading comment ends with the reader's own relay note:

> ⛔ This seat has **no write access to `objectstack-ai/objectui`**, so the objectui#6385 relay this card asks for is **not posted by me** — it is left to the objectui lane's unlock scan; this comment is the record it should relay from.

Measured here: this card's newest comment before mine was 2026-08-25T19:55:21Z, so nothing had reached it since triage. The gap is structural — the seat that could answer cannot write here — not neglect.

---

## The answer

> ## ANSWER — `boolean`. It was boolean when #1238 shipped it, and it is boolean today.
>
> ⛔ Not a timestamp, not a string, not an enum, not nullable-by-design. objectui PR #6383's conservative "populate only on an actual boolean" consumer **matches the producer at both refs and can be pinned**.

Refs read by that seat: cloud PR #1238's merge commit `a0bfa10e02b329636d76c4ec03d97986e84fd4ae` (via the contents API, because that seat's cloud checkout is shallow) and today's cloud `origin/main` `9b6abe0f2fd58e39f1f5ca329940f5cf5d75f50d`.

The producing lines it quoted, in `packages/objectos-runtime/src/ai-token-guardrail-plugin.ts` — a strict-equality derivation, so the expression's type is `boolean`:

```ts
const resetsTonight = decision.blockingKind === 'daily';
```

and the one explicit type declaration PR #1238 added, on the audit seam in `packages/security-enterprise/src/ai-governance/ai-governance-plugin.ts:219`:

```ts
  resetsTonight?: boolean;
```

⇒ **`boolean`, optional on the audit seam, always present on the wire.** Not renamed, not retired, byte-identical on the paid branches between the two refs.

## The block is discharged

This card's discharge condition was exactly one thing: *"the declared type of `error.details.resetsTonight` as `cloud PR #1238` shipped it."* It has been answered, at that ref and at today's `main`, with the producing lines quoted. Nothing about the question remains open.

Triage's charter on this card was two branches and nothing else, and **branch 1 fires**:

> **boolean** ⇒ close this card as confirmed; the existing test becomes a **contract pin** rather than a defensive one.

⇒ Label moved `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. ⛔ I am not claiming, dispatching, or closing it — the disposition is the lane's.

---

## ⚠️ What this answer does NOT settle

Three items, so the next seat does not read "boolean" as "nothing left to know".

**1. What "declared" means here is weaker than the word suggests.** The reader was explicit:

> ⚠️ **Honest limit on the phrase "declared type".** There is no schema object to point at, so "declared" here means *the TypeScript literal the handler returns plus that one interface field* — nothing validates the 429 body at runtime.

Control the reader ran for that absence, so it reads as a property of the repo rather than a failed grep: the whole cloud repo contains exactly **1** `*.zod.ts` file. ⇒ The "contract pin" this card authorises pins objectui's read against a producer-side TypeScript literal, not against a validated envelope. Worth saying in the pin's comment.

**2. A fact the charter did not anticipate — `resetsAt`.** This is *new work the answer surfaced*, ⛔ not a residual block. On 2026-09-02, cloud PR #1852 (rolling 7-day free quota) left the field's name and type alone but inverted the **free-plan value**:

| | free plan, before | free plan, on `9b6abe0` | paid plan, both refs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resetsTonight` | hardcoded `true` | derived ⇒ **`false`** | `true` daily / `false` monthly |
| `resetsAt` | absent | **present**, ISO string | absent |

⇒ The reader's conclusion: *"the widening objectui#6385 may want is therefore not a type widening on `resetsTonight` — that field is and stays `boolean` — but reading the additional optional `resetsAt: string` (ISO 8601) beside it."* So branch 1's "nothing to do" is true of the **type** and not true of the **rendering**: a consumer that renders "it resets tonight" off the flag alone is now silently uninformative for free-plan users. This card's body states no consumer in this repo reads the field yet (⚠️ that is the card's 2026-08-25 statement — I did **not** re-measure it), so nothing is broken today; whether the `resetsAt` read rides on this card or gets its own is the lane's call, and I filed nothing.

Also disambiguated by the reader, to save someone a search: `resetKind: 'weekly'` is **not** in the 429 envelope — it belongs to `GET /api/v1/ai/usage`. Measured 0 occurrences in the 429 producer against 9 and 7 in the usage endpoint and its test.

**3. UNMEASURED-BY-ME.** Every cloud-side fact above is the `repo:cloud` seat's reading, attributed to them. `objectstack-ai/cloud` is **not in this session's scope** — I ran no grep, opened no file, and verified none of it independently. Its stated bounds are theirs too: two refs, source only, no runtime observation.

⛔ Body untouched — this repo's issue-read channel HTML-escapes body text and the write is a whole-body replace, so a "helpful" body edit silently persists the escaped form (objectstack#14898, #6653). Labels and comments only.

## Closing — branch 1 fires. ⚠️ And this card's own "no consumer yet" line is false today; the consumer is the pin.

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. Acting on the charter, which named exactly two branches and nothing else:

> **boolean** ⇒ close this card as confirmed and note the existing test is now a contract pin; **timestamp/other** ⇒ requeue the small widening. Nothing else is chartered.

The answer is **`boolean`**, at cloud PR #1238's merge commit and at today's cloud `main`, with the producing lines quoted. ⇒ **Branch 1. Closed as completed.**

## ⚠️ Correcting this card's own record before it closes

The relay flagged that it had **not** re-measured the card's 2026-08-25 statement that no consumer in this repo reads the field. I measured it. **It is now false.**

| site | what it does |
|:--|:--|
| `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.ts:221` | declares `resetsTonight?: boolean` |
| `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/tool-display.ts:373` | **reads it** — `resetsTonight: asOptionalFlag(details?.resetsTonight, body.resetsTonight)` |
| `tool-display.test.ts:276` | *"leaves `resetsTonight` undefined unless a producer sends an actual boolean"* |
| `tool-display.test.ts:216, :228, :286-297` | the boolean-only and non-boolean-rejection cases |
| `ChatbotEnhanced.quotaBlockedConfirm.test.tsx:44` | exercises it through the quota-blocked path |

⇒ The conservative reader PR #6383 shipped is **live**, and the charter's phrase *"the existing test is now a contract pin"* is not aspirational — those five sites are the pin, and they now pin against a producer type that has been read at two refs.

⭐ One honest limit carries into that pin and belongs in it rather than here: the reader's own caveat is that **"declared" is weaker than it sounds** — there is no schema object to point at, so it means *the TypeScript literal the handler returns plus one interface field*, and **nothing validates the 429 body at runtime**. Control for that absence, run by the reader so it reads as a property of the repo rather than a failed grep: the whole cloud repo contains exactly **one** `*.zod.ts` file. So this pin holds objectui's read against a producer-side TypeScript literal, not against a validated envelope.

## What is NOT closed by this, and is now filed

The answer surfaced a fact the charter could not have anticipated: cloud PR #1852 left `resetsTonight`'s name and type alone but **inverted the free-plan value** (hardcoded `true` → derived **`false`**) and moved the actionable fact to a new optional sibling `resetsAt` (ISO string) that this repo's 429 reader does not read.

⛔ That is **new work the answer surfaced, not a residual block** — which is why it does not hold this card open. Filed separately as **#7587**.

⚠️ Note for anyone following the `resetsAt` thread: this repo already has a live, independent `resetsAt` consumer — `app-shell/src/hooks/useAiUsage.ts:42` and `AiUsageIndicator.tsx:143-168`, which renders "N days"/"N hours" from it and whose own comment says *"Contract-first (objectui#7371) — `resetsAt` is the ONE source of the reset"*. **That is a different envelope.** The cloud reader disambiguated it explicitly: `resetKind`/`resetsAt` on `GET /api/v1/ai/usage` is not the 429 body. Do not read the existing consumer as evidence the 429's new field is handled.

Every cloud-side fact here is the `repo:cloud` seat's reading (objectstack#12361 comment `5520501677`), attributed to them. `objectstack-ai/cloud` is not in this session's scope; nothing about it was verified here. What **was** verified here, on `origin/main`, is the objectui consumer table above.
